summary: Detection Engineering enhancement verified end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (empty-state → rules upload → live dashboard → xsoar overlay → logval pie → cleanup). GET /api/dashboard/detection-engineering?tenant_id=acme-corp returns data_status=live with quality.detection_coverage=99.9, use_case_coverage=93.2, mitre_coverage=92.9, quality_score=97.7, atlas_coverage=null and rule_effectiveness.total_rules=1526, triggered_rules=8, avg_triggers≈11.2, bands.above_avg=3, logval_total=309, priority_breakdown populated. UI: upload modal exposes new sources (Rule Catalog / Log Validation) with dedicated hints; all coverage KPI cards render numeric values while kpi-atlas shows 'N/A · Live'; MITRE heatmap paints all 12 tactics with technique tiles+hit counts; StatChip re-triggered=8, re-above=3, re-near=0, re-nottriggered=1518, first re-row-0 visible; Log Source Priority pie renders; globalbank tenant shows detection-empty-state; success toasts include tenant name (e.g. 'Ingested 309 rows into Detection Engineering (Log Priority) for Acme Corporation'). DB cleaned via DELETE endpoints after tests.

issues: Recharts warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' printed on initial mount before ResponsiveContainer measures parent (benign, charts eventually render).

`result` state is preserved across close/reopen only via reset() on close. Works correctly, but if a user re-opens the modal mid-upload the previous 'Bound to dashboard: NN rows → ...' banner may briefly show until the new API response replaces it (minor UX polish).

critical_code_review_comments: rules_ingest.compute_detection: rule/name matching normalises via _norm_key (alphanumeric-lowercase) — resilient to spacing/case differences between XSOAR incident 'Rule Name' and catalog 'Rule Name'. Verified 90 XSOAR rows → 8 catalog rules matched, avg_triggers=11.2, above_avg=3.
quality.atlas_coverage explicitly set to None so UI can render 'N/A' — correct per requirement (ATLAS not derivable from the catalog).
logval_ingest normalises Essential/Selective/Redundant/Undefined case-insensitively via _KNOWN dict and title-cases unknown values — matches 'Priority values are case-normalized' requirement.
server.upload_data still stores the QRadar file but sets bound_rows=0 with a clear warning — good honest feedback pattern extended to the new sources.
rules_ingest.parse_rows correctly prefers the catalog sheet (Rule Name + ATT&CK columns) with a fallback to the first sheet containing 'rule name' — robust to multi-sheet xlsx workbooks.

Tenant 'acme-corp'. DB cleaned via DELETE /api/dashboard/detection/rules-data, /api/dashboard/detection/logval-data, /api/dashboard/soc-manager/data.
